article.title: Down Home North Carolina is Transforming the State, County by County
article.author: Delaney Vandergrift
article.content: Every two years national media and political pundits characterize North Carolina as purple, blue, red, or an unexplainable secret fourth thing. Cycle after cycle, the media gets it wrong because they’re missing the growing independent political power being built by organizations fighting for working people in corners of the state that political parties have abandoned.
